$comment: Registration for Claude Code (.mcp.json) and anything else that speaks
streamable HTTP. Start Neovim first: the sidecar is its child, and with no
editor there is nothing to connect to.
Drop the `headers` block when `token` is nil in setup() -- that is the
default, and the endpoint binds to loopback only, so there is nothing to
authenticate against. Keep it, with a matching `token = "..."` in setup(),
